title.es: Aquel en el que Isidro no le habla a Fina
title.en: The One Where Isidro Won't Speak to Fina

description.es: Fina intenta hablar con Isidro, pero Isidro se niega a hablar con ella. Fina le dice a Marta que le ha contado a su padre que está enamorada de una mujer. Marta se enfada mucho y discuten. Fina la tranquiliza diciéndole que no dio su nombre y que su reputación no ha quedado manchada.
description.en: Fina tries to talk to Isidro, but Isidro refuses to speak with her. Fina tells Marta that she has told her father she is in love with a woman. Marta becomes very angry, and they argue. Fina reassures her, saying that she did not give her name and that her reputation has not been tarnished.
